posts.name: Pexo
posts.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
posts.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

posts.name: Ferndesk
posts.tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
posts.description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

posts.name: GitBot
posts.tagline: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
posts.description: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. ShipGuard, for example, reads your branch and says merge or block, with file and line evidence. Runs on your machine with the logins you already have. Open source. No account, no telemetry.

posts.name: CrawlRaven MCP
posts.tagline: Your SEO work, done from your AI agent
posts.description: CrawlRaven joins Search Console, GA4, your keyword lists, and a technical crawl of your site into one plan, ranked by impact: what to fix, update and write first. Ask for it in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through our MCP server and get answers from your own data.

posts.name: NotchDodo
posts.tagline: NotchDodo turns your notch into a full-blown dashboard.
posts.description: NotchDodo turns your Mac’s notch into a useful part of your everyday workflow. 🦤 With 14 built-in tools, NotchDodo gives you quick access to handy utilities without interrupting your work. It’s lightweight, simple, and designed specifically for Macs with a notch. Instead of working around the notch, make it useful. 14 tools. One notch. A more useful Mac.

posts.name: Autonomyware
posts.tagline: Idea to physical product, engineer anything you can imagine
posts.description: Autonomyware turns your idea into an engineered physical product. Start with your vision and let autonomous AI handle the engineering process end to end. Describe what you want to create, then move from product definition through architecture, risk, CAD, BOMs, code, verification, and manufacturing preparation. One AI-native workspace keeps every decision and engineering artifact connected from idea to implementation.

posts.name: Aktar
posts.tagline: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS
posts.description: Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

posts.name: Datastory
posts.tagline: Turn the world's data into stories worth sharing
posts.description: Datastory is the no-code platform for data storytellers. Create interactive charts, websites, and reports with AI, and access a growing catalog of open datasets.

posts.name: Evlat
posts.tagline: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you
posts.description: Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.

posts.name: Macaly Cloud
posts.tagline: Build and publish sites with your Claude or ChatGPT
posts.description: Add Macaly Cloud to your Claude or ChatGPT and build websites and apps right from the chat. Macaly provides the database, hosting, domain and 70+ skills the code needs to go live, on the subscription you already pay for. Also works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok Bot.

posts.name: Upsolve Data Models
posts.tagline: Teach AI your metric definitions and business vocabulary
posts.description: Register your data model, metric definitions and business vocabulary once. Upsolve grounds every agent answer in them, versions them like code and refreshes column values nightly, so answers stay correct as your data changes.

posts.name: CoIsland
posts.tagline: Your whole engineering stack, in a notch
posts.description: CoIsland watches CI, deploys, errors, incidents and databases (35+ connectors) and shows only what breaks, in an island on the edge of your Mac's screen. Monitors are plain SQL or shell files. One click hands an alert to Claude Code, Codex or Cortex Code.

posts.name: m’kay
posts.tagline: One voice for all your coding agents, from your phone
posts.description: Talk to the AI agents on your Mac from any browser or phone. Other voice apps talk to one assistant. m’kay talks to all your agents: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on your Mac. Ask which one is done, hear its reply, and tell it what to do next from your phone's browser, on the train, or at the gym. It drives the real desktop apps, so your sessions and projects stay where they are. Nothing is sent until you say "yes" to a read-back. Open source: run it all locally, or use the menu-bar Mac app.

posts.name: Bruto
posts.tagline: A task board that lives in your repo, for you and your AI
posts.description: A brutalist task board for coding with AI. Notes live in your repo: copy the context with one key, or let an agent work the board over MCP and answer in each note. Standing rules, cross-project links and a map of your pages, APIs and tables. Free, open source.

posts.name: jambuild
posts.tagline: Near instant multiplayer vibecoding, just point and talk
posts.description: A multiplayer vibecoding tool where you talk and point with your mouse, and every change lands in seconds. Has limited credits to try it out, and you can BYO API keys to unlock more usage.

posts.name: OpenShip
posts.tagline: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.
posts.description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

posts.name: Agent Identity
posts.tagline: Give every AI agent real identities, inboxes, and a phone
posts.description: AI agents are starting to access APIs, databases, SaaS tools, and other agents but most identity infrastructure wasn't built for them. Agent Identity gives every agent a persistent identity, credentials, permissions, and an audit trail, so developers can control what their agents can access and what they do. Built for developers building real agentic systems.

posts.name: lurk
posts.tagline: Free, open-source Reddit and Twitter lead monitoring
posts.description: lurk watches Reddit and X for people asking for a product like yours, scores each post with a one-line reason, and sends new ones to email, Slack, Discord or a webhook. Also finds the Reddit threads Google ranks for you. Free and open source.

posts.name: Ship It: Idle Dev Tycoon
posts.tagline: The idle game where App Review can reject you
posts.description: A pixel-art idle game about running an app studio. Ship updates, put out fires and survive App Review. Recruit 68 suspiciously familiar advisers, then sell your studio and do it all again. New in 2.0: App Review rejections, eight incidents, a Hall of Fame and a Game Center fortune leaderboard. Free on iPhone.

posts.name: Campfire
posts.tagline: The shared workspace for humans and coding agents
posts.description: Campfire gives humans and coding agents a shared place to work. Run the coding agents you already use and bring their sessions, context, decisions, and progress together in one workspace. Open source and harness-independent.

posts.name: Cyluma
posts.tagline: Your Mac’s battery as a living, breathing landscape
posts.description: Cyluma turns your Mac’s battery into a responsive living landscape. Optimise your battery's health with best parctices. See charge, charging state, time remaining, battery health and energy use from a calm menu-bar companion.

posts.name: Overpath
posts.tagline: Your AI Teammate for Revenue Execution
posts.description: The CRM records the deal. Intelligence tools analyse it. Overpath is what happens next. Molly is an AI teammate for revenue teams - grounded in your methodology, your deals, your context. Molly flags the gap before the call, draft the follow-up before you ask, and show every manager exactly how the pipeline is really being run. No memory loss between chats. No generic advice. No CRM has ever made a rep sell better. Overpath does.

posts.name: Flocker Agent Profiles
posts.tagline: Profile Pages for Agents: your live AI collaboration network
posts.description: Never lose context again! Give your Agent a profile page, live feed, and personal storage. Access it anywhere, and connect more to build your private agent network. Give every agent a job title! AI works better with a clear job description. Log-in and ask your agent to create a new Agent Profile for self-managed context, collaborative agent workflows and task management. Works with all your favourite AI tools incl. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

posts.name: Squint
posts.tagline: Drag a box on your screen and ask AI about it
posts.description: Most AI tools make you screenshot, switch to a chat tab, upload, and switch back. Squint cuts that to one step: press a hotkey, drag a box over anything on your screen, and ask. The answer appears right beside what you selected, and you can ask follow-ups. Fast mode usually starts answering in 1-2 seconds; Best mode gives deeper answers. Built in Rust with native screen capture for speed. Works on Windows 10/11 and Linux (Wayland), with a free tier of 3 captures a day.

posts.name: Bevell
posts.tagline: CAD automation where it counts.
posts.description: Stop redrawing parts by hand. Turn a photo, sketch, scan or PDF into a file you can cut, mill or print. Get an editable DXF and true-scale SVG. Preview unlimited conversions for free. Bevell Sketchpad now in beta.

posts.name: getcta.store
posts.tagline: an ai teleprompter that lives under your MacBook notch
posts.description: getcta is a macOS teleprompter that sits right under your MacBook notch, next to the camera, so your eyes stay on the lens. It follows your voice as you read, highlighting the word you're on and scrolling with you, and it's hidden from Zoom, Meet, OBS and screen recordings. AI helps you write a script from notes, Notion or Google Drive, rewrite it to be easier to say, and fit it to 15s–3min. Speech is recognized on your Mac. Free prompter; Pro is $9/mo.

posts.name: Speek
posts.tagline: A context aware FOSS voice assistant and dictation for macOS
posts.description: Speek is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. Hold a key and talk to dictate into any app, edit selected text, or ask it to take action in your apps and accounts. Point to something on screen by circling it. Speek handles quick requests in the notch and runs longer tasks in the background, then tells you when they are done. It can answer aloud, follow up naturally, and remember details you ask it to keep. Built for macOS.

posts.name: WebinarFlow
posts.tagline: Your pitch on repeat. You only when it counts.
posts.description: Record your demo once. Prospects book and watch whenever suits them. Jump in live only when a real question needs you, then keep the recording rolling. Every answer trains an AI that handles the repeat questions next time.

posts.name: SelfJev
posts.tagline: Jev-compatible self-hosted decisions mode
posts.description: SelfJev is an open 4B decisions model you host yourself. Ask typed questions about any text (yes/no, pick one, pick any, score) and get calibrated probabilities. Jev-compatible: point TypeSafe's SDK at your server with two env vars. Fine-tune it on your data.

posts.name: freddy.health
posts.tagline: talk to your body in Claude, ChatGPT, Muse, or any other AI
posts.description: Connect your Garmin, Polar, Oura, Withings, Intervals.icu, Hevy, WHOOP, Suunto, Concept2 and more to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, or any AI that speaks MCP. Sleep, recovery, HRV, workouts, queryable in natural language.

posts.name: Foglio
posts.tagline: Simple, private docs with smart AI templates, zero bloat.
posts.description: The simple document editor for everything you create. Private, clutter-free editing with smart templates for contracts, invoices, meeting notes, and more. Free forever.

posts.name: Dental Scope
posts.tagline: Explore dental anatomy in 3D, tooth by tooth
posts.description: Dental Scope is a free, open source 3D dental learning tool for exploring teeth and surrounding structures in detail. Explore all 32 permanent teeth, switch between FDI, Universal and Palmer numbering systems, and study structures from enamel and dentin to pulp, root canals, jaws, nerves and vessels.

posts.name: Ace from Automat Workforce
posts.tagline: Meet Ace, an agentic teammate for work
posts.description: Hi! Lucas here from Automat, stoked to share what the team's been heads-down on: Ace. It’s Instinct or Muse but for work. The TL;DR: you can now hire an AI coworker. Ace shows up with its own computer, phone number, inbox, and logins, works inside the tools you already use, and hands back finished work- not just status updates. We’ve got a 14-day free trial, which should make it super easy to try out.. so.. try it out! and let us know what you think.

posts.name: Rinkata
posts.tagline: One source of truth for your team and its AI agents
posts.description: Rinkata keeps product intent connected from idea to deploy, so your team and its AI agents build the same thing. Goals, specs, decisions, and completion evidence live in one shared hub that Claude, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok read and write over MCP. Agents search your knowledge before inventing context, humans make the judgment calls, and finished work ships with proof (tests, screenshots, PRs) that writes itself back into your docs.

posts.name: Voice Memo
posts.tagline: Open-source voice notes that file your tasks and reminders
posts.description: You think of things while walking or driving, record a voice note, and never play it again. Voice Memo does the listening. It pulls out the tasks, decisions, questions and reminders, files them into the right project, and updates the old ones when you change your mind. Reminders ring like an alarm, and Claude can answer questions about your notes. Open source and MIT. You run your own copy on Cloudflare's free tier, so it costs $0 a month and your notes are stored in your own account.

posts.name: RxFilmStudio
posts.tagline: Create and edit Product videos with your AI Agent
posts.description: Create and edit videos by simply telling AI what you want. RxFilm Studio turns ideas, websites, screenshots, footage, and screen recordings into polished videos, then lets you refine every scene with natural language. Make precise edits to timing, layouts, animations, transitions, voiceovers, music, and subtitles without regenerating the whole video. You can also record product demos with smart cursor tracking and automatic click zooms—all in one AI-native video workspace.

posts.name: Notely
posts.tagline: Turn notes into tasks, with AI that asks first
posts.description: Turn scattered notes into tasks, calendar plans, and follow-ups. Notely’s AI assistant searches your notes and connected apps, proposes the steps, and waits for your approval before making changes. Keep your ideas and your work moving together.

posts.name: Styx
posts.tagline: An agentic development environment (ADE) for Mac
posts.description: The desktop app where your work converges: every repo you touch, the AI agents building in them, and every login they need to ship. One window for all of it, and nothing crosses into production without you. Mac now, Windows soon.

posts.name: Zumbo
posts.tagline: Open source local AI voice-to-text for Mac for private STT
posts.description: Zumbo uses local AI models on your Mac to instantly turn what you say into text, with near perfect accuracy and complete privacy, in every app. About a fifth of a second from the end of your sentence to text in the app. 21 vocabulary packs, from developer tools to legal, medical and design, and it learns from your corrections: wrong once, never again. Notes with reminders, meetings with speaker labels. Works with the Wi-Fi off, no account. One-time price, open source.

posts.name: WhisperBrain
posts.tagline: Your second brain for meetings.
posts.description: WhisperBrain listens locally, remembers what your team decided, and turns every meeting into searchable memory inside Obsidian.

posts.name: myjobb AI
posts.tagline: agent that applies jobs for you.
posts.description: An AI job agent that sends applications and tailors resumes for every job that fits your profile, on your behalf. tracks your applications in realtime, keeps you in the loop; nothing goes out without your consent.

posts.name: Partsify
posts.tagline: Know what a salvage car will cost to fix before you bid
posts.description: Buying at Copart or IAAI means bidding on photos. Partsify turns a lot link into a repair estimate in minutes: the visibly damaged parts, each part's OEM number and current supplier price with a link to buy it, estimated labor hours, and a grand total. No inspector, no waiting. Start with a free scan, then reports from $9.99 (down to $5 in packs). Covers 31 makes. Dealers, importers and body shops can go unlimited or plug in through our API.

posts.name: Cookie Consent SDK
posts.tagline: Open-source consent management for React and Next.js
posts.description: Manage cookie consent in code for React and Next.js. Control when third-party tools like GA4, GTM and Meta Pixel load, and keep everything in your frontend. MIT licensed. One command to install, no account or dashboard.

posts.name: Launchpad Fast
posts.tagline: Get your project discovered, AI visibility check and more.
posts.description: Find startup directories to submit your project. Compare domain ratings, traffic estimates, listing requirements, and submission reviews.

posts.name: Call an Insider
posts.tagline: 15-min career calls between students and professionals.
posts.description: When I was a student, I had no one to ask. A dozen professionals gave me fifteen minutes each, and that's how I got into investment banking. Years later, I built what I wish had existed. Call an Insider: students and recent graduates book a free 15-minute call with someone who does the job they want. Real people, real firms, in a few clicks. Insiders are volunteers. No fees, no upsell. Professionals: be the call you wish you'd had at 22.

posts.name: Hidden Events
posts.tagline: Every Luma event in your city, not just the featured 20%
posts.description: Luma's discover page features only ~20% of the events in your city. Hidden Events shows all of them — every public Luma event across 27 cities (NYC, SF, LA, London, Singapore, Bangalore, Mumbai + 20 more), crawled every 4 hours. Tech & AI meetups, founder dinners, hackathons, run clubs, comedy, workshops. Browse by today, this weekend or category, and see at a glance which events Luma hides. Free, no signup. Not affiliated with Luma.

posts.name: techconfessions.lol
posts.tagline: the most hilarious tech confessions on the internet!
posts.description: A confession booth for developers, founders and vibe coders. Tap the mic, confess in 30 seconds, and it posts as anonymous text. Strangers absolve it, burn it, or hit "same".

posts.name: PeopleSocial: X + AI Caption Generation
posts.tagline: Turn your employees into an AI-powered distribution engine
posts.description: PeopleSocial helps teams turn employee networks into a distribution engine with AI Caption Generation and X integration. Create personalized captions from brand content, let employees share and track analytics across social channels, all from one place.

posts.name: Colleator
posts.tagline: X collaboration marketplace
posts.description: Colleator helps X creators and businesses find each other for paid collaborations without the usual back-and-forth. Creators can build profiles, showcase their X performance, list collaboration services, set pricing, and show they’re open to sponsorships. Businesses, SaaS founders, and builders can discover relevant creators by niche and audience, see what they offer upfront, and collaborate without guessing rates or sending endless cold DMs.

posts.name: HQ
posts.tagline: The company brain your AI runs on
posts.description: Today everyone uses AI their own way. HQ gets your whole team working as one. A workspace that makes your AI smarter the more you use it, and turns one person's wins into the whole team's default. You get sharper. They get faster.

posts.name: Tipza
posts.tagline: Fair and transparent tip splits for teams
posts.description: Tipza helps teams split tips fairly and transparently. Add the total, choose equal, hours, points or custom weights, and share the breakdown.

posts.name: Lobbi - Hotel Spend Companion
posts.tagline: Compare hotel supply prices as you browse
posts.description: Free Chrome extension for hotel operators that compares prices across 50+ supply vendors while you shop. Lobbi normalizes pack sizes, surfaces shipping and delivery details when available, and shows potential savings, without extra tabs or spreadsheets.

posts.name: Synclify
posts.tagline: The agent that runs your Instagram
posts.description: Synclify puts your whole Instagram in one place: content, DMs, brand deals, invoices, analytics, ads, competitors. You ask, the assistant does it, and it checks with you before it changes anything. It never shows you a number it can't back up. Every figure shows where it came from, and if something wasn't measured, it says so instead of showing you a zero. Built for creators, brands and agencies. Each account gets its own workspace, and clients can sign off on a post before it goes out.

posts.name: Report Card
posts.tagline: Get grades for your social media accounts
posts.description: Grade any public X, Threads or LinkedIn account like a school report card. Six subjects, a GPA, a teacher's comment, one slip to share. No login.

posts.name: Ravenclip
posts.tagline: Turn your industry's news into short expert videos
posts.description: Ravenclip turns the news in your field into short expert videos and posts them for you, so agencies, consultants and coaches become the expert their prospects see every week, without filming. It posts to TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.

posts.name: Swipefast
posts.tagline: A simple checkout for products & services
posts.description: Checkout for coaches and creators: order bumps, one-click upsells, subscriptions and affiliate tracking. $49/month.

posts.name: eGuard
posts.tagline: Parental controls, verified
posts.description: Set screen time, bedtime, app and web rules on your child's Android or iPhone, and see each one confirmed on the device. Free for 1 child; plans from ₱149 a month.

posts.name: GetCited | MCP driven SEO
posts.tagline: Let your AI optimise your organic traffic on autopilot
posts.description: Where the product differs from other SEO tools: - We don't code or generate anything. We report. Your agent decides to act or not. No bad surprise. Always on target. - Agent first. No manual work, autopilot is the name of the game. Monitor your agent's work in our dashboard if you feel like reverting some of his work. - No hallucinations. Your agent has your repo, we don't. The MCP just gives the tools he needs. - Self-healing funnel. Posthog session replay data for AI to tune the user flow.

posts.name: Flint — You talk, Flint writes.
posts.tagline: You talk, Flint writes. No subscription, no $99/year.
posts.description: You talk. Flint writes. Speak freely — walking, driving, cooking. Flint turns it into clean notes, todos, or key points in seconds. Because half-formed ideas, errands, and Monday follow-ups shouldn't live rent-free in your head. Transcribed. Summarized. Organized. And unlike tools charging $75–99/year just to take your own notes — Flint doesn't. Pay once, or only for what you use. Your voice. Your notes. Your peace of mind.

posts.name: Commerce.design
posts.tagline: Discover, collect, and share e-commerce design inspiration.
posts.description: "What was that site again, the one that blew me away?" "I have no idea where to start on this new project." Commerce.design is where e-commerce design references live. Browse for inspiration, keep it organized, and share it with your team when the next brief lands. Free, growing every day, built with the community. Including you.

posts.name: Plumber
posts.tagline: Every bug in your side-project app becomes a test case
posts.description: Point your coding agent at Plumber and it becomes the maintainer of the app you built for yourself and shared with friends. Every "that was wrong" becomes a saved case, fixes happen on a branch, and a fix ships only if every case passes.

posts.name: Bread Crumbs
posts.tagline: Reinventing the Call Center — AI-Powered Omnichannel Support
posts.description: Boost customer engagement with AI-powered conversations. Manage chats, automate support with AI, and capture feedback in one unified inbox.

posts.name: Quiddo
posts.tagline: Pocket money and chores for kids, no debit card
posts.description: Quiddo tracks pocket money and chores for families who don't want to give their kids a debit card. You keep paying the way you already do, with your own card or cash, and log it in the app. Kids open Quiddo on their own device to see their balance and savings goals. Pocket money goes out on a set day and can depend on chores getting done. $15 a year for the whole family, on iOS, Android and the web. Built by a Melbourne family with four kids.

posts.name: Move
posts.tagline: move/relocation planner
posts.description: Relocating? Upload photos of your belongings and get an instant AI-powered material list, approximate price and moving quotes from trusted local companies. Fast, free, and built for expats in France.

posts.name: SupaClip
posts.tagline: Everything you've copied. One shortcut away.
posts.description: Clipboard history for macOS with search, pins and previews. Press ⌘⇧V, type a few letters, press return. Pay once, no subscription, nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Ghostmotion
posts.tagline: Turn your product into a cinematic film in minutes
posts.description: Make launch films, product ads, and trailers with an agentic video harness that uses the right video models for each shot and then cuts your film to your chosen music.

posts.name: Clockwork
posts.tagline: Book coding agents like meetings. Wake up to the report.
posts.description: Book Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Hermes on a calendar. Clockwork runs each job in a sandboxed git worktree, caps the spend, pauses risky steps for your approval (even on your phone), and files a report you can turn into a PR. Pipelines, worker Macs, a CLI.

posts.name: Synthetic Webcam Scene Dataset
posts.tagline: 17,280 synthetic webcam images for computer vision
posts.description: 17,280 text-generated webcam images in 12 categories, with prompts, provenance and companion source code. Built for computer-vision experiments exploring human proctor assistance. USD 99 once, with a free 240-image sample. No trained model included.

posts.name: Lanjut
posts.tagline: Free Open-Source Local-First ATS-Friendly Resume Builder
posts.description: Lanjut is a free, open-source resume builder that stays entirely in your browser; no account, nothing uploaded. Style it freely; every export is structured to sail through applicant tracking systems.

posts.name: useClick.io
posts.tagline: Short links, link in bio and analytics in one dashboard
posts.description: useClick.io tracks your whole online presence in one dashboard. Create short links on your own domain with QR codes, geo-targeting, click limits and email capture. Build link in bio pages where every button is a tracked short link. Add cookie-free website analytics with one script tag, and see visitor journeys, goals and funnels and a live 3D globe. Ask your AI assistant about your numbers through our MCP server. No cookies, no consent banner, no IP addresses stored. Free to start.

posts.name: Street Whisperer
posts.tagline: Turn your next city walk into a personal audio tour
posts.description: Walk past a beautiful building and wonder what happened there? Street Whisperer turns nearby landmarks, architecture and hidden corners into audio stories. Wander freely or pick a duration and theme for a tailored walk. New: museum mode with major works explained one by one, weekly rankings and a play button right on your lock screen. Ask your AI guide follow-up questions. iPhone and Android, 15 languages. Free to start, no account required.

posts.name: Ember by PubCrush
posts.tagline: Meet people in the same pub, tonight
posts.description: Ember helps you meet people in the same pub, tonight. Check in at a participating venue, see who's there and send a private wave. You only find out when the interest is mutual. Match, meet at the bar and claim the venue's reward together. Your waves and matches disappear after closing; your profile stays. Free for guests, 18+. Available on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Eminex
posts.tagline: Your brand on autopilot, everywhere they search
posts.description: Eminex makes your brand the answer everywhere customers search — AI assistants, Google, Maps, and social — writing, publishing and optimising around the clock.

posts.name: PatriotMurica
posts.tagline: Conservative community, Republican news & patriotic apparel
posts.description: PatriotMurica is a home for proud Americans. Members get a private app with the Republican News Desk (AI briefs of the day’s top stories), a Midterms 2026 tracker, the events calendar, a live members’ forum, private messages, member profiles, state and county chapters, live streams and Patriots Love for singles. Anyone can explore 250 years of American history and shop original patriotic apparel. Try any membership free for 7 days, no card needed.

posts.name: Pesky
posts.tagline: Pesky monitors your competitors (so you don't have to)
posts.description: Pesky finds the competitors circling your moat and watches them every day on autopilot. Free scan: type your site, get 10 rivals back in about 30 seconds.

posts.name: QueerCade
posts.tagline: Gayming Archive
posts.description: Browse a hand-picked database of games with LGBTQ+ characters and stories — featured picks, curated collections, and a library you can track your own play through.

posts.name: cursed.boo
posts.tagline: Online curse generator
posts.description: A harmless joke curse for whoever wronged you. They get a link — and know exactly what they did.

posts.name: NyattoLandforX
posts.tagline: Cats that live, play, and help you read your X timeline
posts.description: NyattoLandforX is a Chrome extension that turns your X timeline into a tiny world inhabited by cats. Cats walk across posts, climb walls, jump out of quote cards, and fall asleep — while useful cues like follow status, engagement signals, and interaction history quietly appear alongside them. Everything runs locally in your browser, with no external tracking.

posts.name: Best Fit
posts.tagline: A leaderboard for your exact job, not for everything.
posts.description: Describe the job in plain English and Best Fit builds a leaderboard just for it, weighting the published benchmarks that matter, plus price, speed and the right reasoning setting. "Count the squirrels on every frame from my wildlife camera", "code locally on a 32GB MacBook", "animate my kid's drawing": each gets its own ranking. Rebuilt daily, with an MCP server so your coding agent stops recommending last year's models. Free.

posts.name: Herd
posts.tagline: The creator economy runs on eleven tabs. Herd is one.
posts.description: The creator economy runs on about eleven browser tabs. Herd puts it in one place. Creators schedule posts to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and X, answer brands from their own Gmail or Outlook, send proposals and contracts, and get paid through Stripe straight to their bank. Brands run campaigns, find creators and approve content. Agencies manage their roster, commissions and client portals. One deal, one record all three sides can see. Free plan for creators. Built in the UK.

posts.name: Lemma
posts.tagline: Open-source ChatGPT Space + Dots for your whole team
posts.description: Open-source Space + Dots + Lovable for teams. Give AI teammates ongoing responsibilities, shared knowledge, and the tools to act. They delegate to each other, bring in the right human for approval on Slack or WhatsApp, and carry the work through to completion. Everyone works from the same context, with clear ownership and permissions. What your team teaches them becomes shared instructions and repeatable workflows. Choose your models. Keep your team's knowledge.

posts.name: ZUUZ
posts.tagline: AI that finds the deals your CRM never recorded
posts.description: ZUUZ sits on top of the CRM your team already runs. It connects to your sales inbox, calendar, meetings and LinkedIn messages, finds the leads, pricing requests and renewal signals that never reached the CRM, and prepares updates for a person to approve. Works with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Attio and Pipedrive. Ask your pipeline from Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no credit card. Or take the Prospect Discovery Challenge: five missing prospects, or $100 (US only).

posts.name: transcript.im
posts.tagline: AI transcript generator for YouTube, TikTok and Instagram
posts.description: transcript.im is an AI transcript generator for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and X videos, plus your own audio and video files. Paste a link or upload an MP4, MP3, podcast, meeting or lecture recording to get a timestamped transcript: captions when they exist, AI speech to text when they don't. Summarize the video, translate the transcript, turn it into a mind map or a new script, and export TXT, SRT or VTT subtitles. Transcribe a whole YouTube channel or playlist in one batch.

posts.name: Talos by FACTA.dev
posts.tagline: Stop rebuilding AI infrastructure. Own the 8-module codebase
posts.description: This is why your AI startup isn't shipping yet. You're not slow because of your product. You're building infrastructure — auth, billing,agent orchestration, analytics, compliance, from scratch, every time. Every AI startup builds the same infrastructure: 4-8 months and $150K-$300K before your actual product ships. That's runway you never get back — spent on code that isn't your product. The question isn't whether you can build it. It's: why would you?

posts.name: WavezOS
posts.tagline: Increase your Shopify store's AI search engine visibility.
posts.description: WavezOS helps Shopify merchants see whether AI assistants name their store when shoppers ask for product recommendations. It builds questions from your catalog, runs visibility scans, and scores how often your brand is mentioned versus competitors you track. You can generate answer first blog posts and pages from those questions, edit them, and publish them to your store. WavezOS also creates llms.txt and agents.md from your products so you can add them to your theme for AI crawlers.

posts.name: PandaSend Terminal
posts.tagline: Your Mac's terminal, on your phone
posts.description: Start a build, a deploy, a dev server or a coding agent on your Mac, then open the same running session on your phone. Every terminal tool, one app. Free on your Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted everywhere else.

posts.name: 72QR
posts.tagline: Make Scannable Art
posts.description: 72QR is a conversation based QR code design tool that transforms standard QR codes into scannable artworks. While most AI based QR code generators have steep learning curve for users to make scannable artworks, our conversational AI agent enables new users to create QR Art that they want in a couple of minutes.

posts.name: Melete
posts.tagline: Personal AI open-source alternative to Dots & Muse.
posts.description: Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. OpenAI just gave everyone an agent with its own computer. We built one you actually own. Melete runs day and night on its own machine, works through your apps, follows up while you sleep and pings you only when it matters. Open source, any model, runs on your hardware. Melete works on its own computer. It comes back only when something needs your approval. Bring any model, run it on your own machine, and see everything it has learned about you.

posts.name: Kakunin
posts.tagline: KYC of AI agents with cryptographic identity
posts.description: Kakunin (kakunin.ai) is the leading Know Your Agent (KYA) platform. Issue X.509 cryptographic identities, monitor real-time AI behavior, and generate EU AI Act & MiCA compliance reports.

posts.name: Low Battery Camera
posts.tagline: SHOOT BEFORE DEATH.
posts.description: Low Battery Camera SHOOT BEFORE DEATH. My phone was getting old. Its battery wasn’t what it used to be. Long recordings? Not happening. I couldn’t afford a new phone or a battery replacement. So I built Low Battery Camera. Key features: Save every drop, segregated local gallery with pin, FAST transfer iPhone ↔ Android, It miaowws. Our battery is dying anyway. Make every shot count.

posts.name: Openmemo
posts.tagline: Turn your project board into a live client status page
posts.description: Openmemo turns your Notion, ClickUp, Linear, Asana, Trello, Jira or Monday board into a branded status page your clients can check any time. You choose what they see. Rename statuses, hide internal tasks, strip shorthand. "Blocked" becomes "Waiting on you." Nothing internal ever leaks, and we only read your board, never write to it. Turn on weekly updates and it emails your client for you. No tool? Paste your last update email instead. Free for one client.

posts.name: Jeeves
posts.tagline: Turn repeat work into reusable AI workflows
posts.description: Jeeves is a desktop app for reusable AI workflows. Set up the steps for a task, run them with your input, and review the result. Start with a weekly update: notes in, draft and check, update out. Change the steps in a visual editor and reuse them next week. Add human input when the workflow should wait for you. Free and open source for Mac, Windows, and Linux.

posts.name: Rizz Me
posts.tagline: AI wingman. AirDrop a link, get her number - Free
posts.description: Rizz Me is an AI wingman for shy guys in the wild. Instead of freezing mid-conversation, you AirDrop (or hand over) a short link — she talks to a charming AI for 30 seconds, then you get her contact + a ready-to-send opener. What’s different: no signup, no creepy profile scrape, and results land on your phone — not hers. Go 1:1 AirDrop, classic phone handoff, or multi-drop the same link to everyone nearby and stack replies live. Built for bars, parties, and “I saw her across the room” moments.

posts.name: Tracky
posts.tagline: Open-source budgeting with a cash flow forecast
posts.description: Tracky connects a zero-based budget plan with a day-by-day cash-flow forecast. Start with a manual account, record or import transactions, assign money to categories, and add upcoming expenses. The dashboard shows how those commitments affect your projected balance, including when it could go below zero. Explore reports to understand spending. The hosted app is free to try, and the code is open source under MIT.

posts.name: ExportMyResume
posts.tagline: LinkedIn profile to PDF or Word resume in one click
posts.description: Import your LinkedIn profile in one click, edit every section, customize fonts and spacing, and export an ATS-friendly resume as PDF, DOCX and more. It works with your own signed-in profile, so your LinkedIn profile doesn't have to be public. Completely free.

posts.name: answer4me
posts.tagline: AI answers your phone calls — like a real person
posts.description: AI picks up when you can't. Your callers have a real conversation — not a robot menu. It finds out who's calling, why, and how urgent it is, then texts you a summary. Set up in 2 minutes: sign up, get your AI number, forward your phone. That's it. Spam calls? Handled. VIP contacts? Put straight through. Pro plan books appointments into your Google Calendar. Choose from 8 AI voices. Works with any phone in UK, US, and Canada. 5 free calls to try. No card needed. From £9/month.

posts.name: gpu-font
posts.tagline: Match font in browser webGPU from Google Fonts and more
posts.description: Crop a line of text and get the closest fonts from Google Fonts, DaFont, Adobe Fonts, GitHub font repositories, Debian and more, with their weight and italic.

posts.name: FFmpeg Commander
posts.tagline: A web GUI for generating FFmpeg command-line operations.
posts.description: Build FFmpeg commands in your browser with a visual editor for video, audio, filters, formats, and presets.

posts.name: PlainInvoice
posts.tagline: Make an invoice, download the PDF. No account needed.
posts.description: Free invoice generator with no signup required. Create professional invoices in seconds, invite team members, and manage clients with role-based access. Perfect for freelancers and small businesses.

posts.name: AetherWave Project Studio
posts.tagline: Edit video in your browser with AI right on the timeline
posts.description: Project Studio is a full timeline video editor in your browser. Five lanes: video, overlay, music, voiceover, text. Keyframe volume, opacity, scale and position by moving a slider. The AI editor works on the real timeline: animate a still, extend a shot from its last frame, bridge two clips, add a voiceover or a score. Normalize audio, master limiter, effects rack. Everything you make on AetherWave is already in your library. Editing and rendering are free.
